user.title: Add OCI Object Storage bucket
user.description: Store Home Assistant backups in an Oracle Cloud Object Storage bucket using the S3 Compatibility API.

data_description.namespace: Your tenancy's Object Storage namespace. Shown on the bucket details page, or run `oci os ns get`. See [Oracle documentation]({namespace_docs_url}).
data_description.region: OCI region identifier of the bucket, e.g. af-johannesburg-1.
data_description.bucket: Bucket must already exist and be writable by the provided credentials.
data_description.access_key_id: Access key of a Customer Secret Key.
data_description.secret_access_key: Secret of the Customer Secret Key. It is only shown once when created. See [Oracle documentation]({secret_key_docs_url}).
data_description.prefix: Optional folder path inside the bucket. Example: backups/homeassistant

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure OCI Object Storage bucket
reconfigure.description: Update the bucket settings or rotate the Customer Secret Key. The secret key must be entered again.
